instruction: Download the CIF structure file of mp-149 (Si) from Materials Project using mp_api. Then open the CIF file in VESTA to visualize the crystal structure. Remove one Si atomic site from the structure, and save the modified file to the desktop as 'Si_half.vesta'.

result.description: The VESTA file contains a Si crystal structure with one Si atomic site removed compared to the original mp-149 structure (which has 2 Si atoms in the conventional cell). The file should be a valid VESTA format file.
